# T-3: Checkpoint cross-check

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Apply WorkUnit checkpoints to loop review cross-check and implement retryable parent chunk fallback splitting.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R7 passes with cross-check checkpoints keyed by chunk summary hashes.
- R8 passes with child WorkUnits after two retryable failureKind checkpoints for the same parent chunk.
- Aggregation expands child results at the parent position without writing a parent success checkpoint.

## Implementation Notes
Preserve the existing cross-check condition of at least two summaries and remaining capacity under `MAX_LOOP_CALLS`. Child WorkUnits must carry parentUnitId and target one group each. Do not split child WorkUnits again.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests with `// spec: R7 ...` and `// spec: R8 ...` headers cover cross-check save/reuse and two-failure fallback splitting. Assert child count is bounded by parent group count, child WorkUnits are not recursively split, sibling chunks are reused, and aggregation order is stable.
